sentences.sentence: Television is a very important technology in the world today.
Video games have a lot of good effects on people's lives.
The internet is good for communicating with people all over the world.
On the other hand, there are bad effects from television as well.
Because of these bad effects, I think robots are bad overall.
Despite the bad effects, I think television is good overall.
As you can see, smartphones are a very important technology.
I think you'll agree that it has a good effect on people overall.
